title: Funkled and Focus Partner to Turn Financial Education into Advice-Ready Clients
author: Unknown
description: Financial education platform Funkled has partnered with advice technology provider Focus to integrate digital client engagement tools directly into its free learning platform. Starting August 1st, Funkled will launch a 30-day content programme with daily modules and podcasts covering financial topics, aiming to address the UK's advice gap where only 8.7% of adults take financial advice.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Focus is expanding its institutional-grade planning tools' reach beyond existing advisory clients to earlier stages of the customer journey through Funkled's platform. This partnership enables the company to engage prospective clients earlier and reach employers and advisers with pre-qualified audiences.

title: What This Invesco Insider Move Signals With the Stock Up 63%
author: Jonathan Ponciano
description: Invesco senior managing director Jeffrey H. Kupor sold 26,002 shares valued at $702,314 on July 2, 2026, but this was a non-discretionary tax withholding event related to restricted stock unit vesting, not a voluntary sale. The transaction is insignificant for investors to monitor. More importantly, Invesco posted its 11th consecutive quarter of positive organic growth with $22 billion in net inflows, $2.2 trillion in assets under management, and raised its dividend while authorizing a $1 billion buyback.

The company noted that past dividend amounts do not guarantee future payments and that portions of some distributions may include return of principal.

title: Investors Will Soon Have Two New Alternatives to Invesco QQQ
author: Matthew Benjamin
description: BlackRock and State Street have filed with the SEC to launch their own Nasdaq-100 tracking ETFs, ending Invesco's monopoly in this category. The move comes after Nasdaq recently expanded access to the index. Invesco QQQ, which tracks the Nasdaq-100 and has $372.5 billion in assets, will now face direct competition from these two major investment firms.

title: What's Going On With Broadcom Stock Monday?
author: Lekha Gupta
description: Broadcom shares trade higher in premarket as the company announces new AI infrastructure chips (Tomahawk 6 and Taurus BCM83640) entering production. The company projects Q2 revenue of $22B, beating estimates of $20.68B, with 68% adjusted EBITDA margins. JPMorgan rates it a top semiconductor pick with potential to exceed $100B in AI chip revenues in fiscal 2027.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Strong new product announcements (Tomahawk 6 and Taurus BCM83640) with full production and customer shipments, Q2 revenue guidance significantly beating estimates ($22B vs $20.68B), positive analyst sentiment from JPMorgan as top semiconductor pick, and strong 12-month performance (up 65.63%). Technical indicators show bullish MACD configuration despite neutral RSI.
ETF showing positive price action (+2.45%) as a result of broad risk-on market sentiment and Broadcom's strength as a significant holding in growth-focused portfolios.
Semiconductor ETF gaining (+1.75%) driven by improved chip sector sentiment and Broadcom's strong performance as a major semiconductor index component.
Broad market momentum ETF up 0.79% as S&P 500 futures gain 0.79% on improved risk-on sentiment and tech strength.
